signer.description: Signer address; must be the majority owner of pool shares.

fee_pct.description: Deprecated: fee_pct is the legacy pool swap fee percentage (cosmos.Dec string in [0,1)). Use fee_rate field 11 instead. Migration logic should read this and convert to fee_rate format (two DecCoins, one per reserve denom in canonical order).

min_collateral_ratio.description: Leverage configuration (per-denom) Required: minimum collateral ratio per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order; > 1)

max_leverage_ratio.description: Required: maximum leverage ratio per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order; > 1)

interest_rate.description: Required: annual interest rates per reserve denom (APR >= 0). Input may include 0, 1, or 2 entries; keeper normalizes to exactly two in canonical pool order.

max_borrow_percent.description: Optional: maximum borrow capacity per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order). Amounts in [0,1).

liquidation_threshold.description: Required: collateral ratio liquidation threshold per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order; each amount is a LegacyDec string > 1)

fee_rate.description: Per-denom swap fee rates (amounts in [0,1)). Allow 0, 1, or 2 entries; keeper normalizes to exactly two entries in canonical pool order. Replaces deprecated fee_pct field 3.

bound_percent.description: Optional: directional price-impact bounds keyed by the sold denom. When provided, must contain exactly two entries in canonical pool order. Amounts must satisfy 0 < x <= 1; x == 1 disables the bound for that denom. Omit the field to leave bounds unchanged.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.title: Dec Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.description: DecCoin defines a token with a denomination and a decimal amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Dec which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.
